_comment: Engine settings (roadmap P5 step 8, docs/API_CONTRACTS.md). Read and checked at start-up by ArabiziCore's EngineConfig; the engine code holds no copy of these numbers. `model` is an id from config/models.json (file, SHA-256 and prompt come from there). The fine-tuned Llama 3.2 1B is switched on (ADR 0005, 16 Oct 2026); if its file is not in models/ when the keyboard is built, or does not match its SHA-256, the engine uses the rules.
